written_before: the seed was picked and before any v4 bundle, port or release file was built. The bake-off scores of both MiniLM seeds exist (experiments/gidi-en-backbone-bakeoff); this file fixes which number picks between them before it is computed.
scope: ship the bake-off winner (MiniLM-L12-H384-uncased student, type + target + value heads, WordPiece uncased, vocabulary 20,500 rows) as gidi-en-v4 / release 4.0.0. No training, no new seed, no re-evaluation: the weights and every reported score are the bake-off's (experiments/gidi-en-backbone-bakeoff/runs/minilm/seed{1,2}).
label_provenance: silver-claude-clef-regex, as gidi-en v3. Every number is agreement with silver labels, not human truth.

seed_rule.statistic: dev composite = arithmetic mean of four int8, snapped scores on the DEV split only (datasets/annotation-en-v1/splits/dev.jsonl, n=189): type macro-F1, target exact, joint (type and target both exact), value exact. It is the bake-off composite (mean of equally weighted type/target/joint/value scores) restricted to the one set that is neither the test split nor a probe; the bake-off's five parts are test-secondary and probe scores and are NOT used to pick.
seed_rule.decision: the seed with the higher dev composite is the candidate. If the two dev composites are within 0.002 of each other (absolute difference <= 0.002), pick seed 1.
seed_rule.forbidden: any test, probe or secondary score as an input to the choice; adding or re-training a seed; ensembling or weight averaging; checkpoint selection.

release_naming: model version gidi-en-v4, release 4.0.0 (docs/releasing.md section 9: MAJOR equals the model's vN).

bundle_contract.tokenizer_type: wordpiece (uncased BERT basic tokenizer + greedy longest-match WordPiece, [CLS] A [SEP], right truncation to max_length 32); the roberta/BPE bundles are type bpe.
bundle_contract.value_decoding: argmax over [O, B-VALUE, I-VALUE] per real token, the highest-confidence span (geometric mean of P(predicted tag) over its tokens, ties to the earlier span), extended to whole words (value_snap words), exactly the decode scripts/evaluate_en_value.py scored. No CRF.

acceptance_gate: TS WordPiece tokenizer ids and offsets identical to the Python tokenizer on every test, dev and probe note and on the fuzz strings of the committed fixture
release verify passes (hashes, runtime config, INT8 and FP32 smoke predictions)
pnpm parity:en: tokenizer, decoder and word snap exact on the MiniLM bundle; ORT numerics reported

seed_result.reason: seed 1 has the higher dev composite (+0.0110, more than the 0.002 tie band); not a tie fallback.
